{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_79",
      "title": "Cloud SQL uses an outdated PostgreSQL major version",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance is pinned to PostgreSQL 14 rather than the latest supported major version, shortening its remaining support window and delaying newer security improvements."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_110",
      "title": "pgAudit is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not enable cloudsql.enable_pgaudit, reducing the availability of detailed database audit events for investigations and compliance monitoring."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_51",
      "title": "Checkpoint logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_checkpoints flag is absent, preventing checkpoint activity from being captured for operational and forensic analysis."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_52",
      "title": "Connection logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_connections flag is absent, so successful connection attempts are not explicitly recorded for monitoring and investigation."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_53",
      "title": "Disconnection logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_disconnections flag is absent, limiting visibility into database session termination and session duration."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_108",
      "title": "Client hostnames are not logged",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_hostname flag is absent, reducing contextual information available when tracing database client activity."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_54",
      "title": "Lock wait logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_lock_waits flag is absent, preventing lock-related delays and suspicious contention from being explicitly logged."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_109",
      "title": "PostgreSQL minimum message logging is not configured",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_min_messages flag is absent, so the required ERROR-level logging threshold is not explicitly enforced."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_11",
      "title": "Cloud SQL is authorized for access from the internet",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "An authorized network permits 0.0.0.0/0, allowing connection attempts from every IPv4 address."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_6",
      "title": "Incoming SSL connections are not required",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "require_ssl is explicitly false, permitting database connections without transport encryption."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_60",
      "title": "Cloud SQL has a public IPv4 interface",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "ipv4_enabled is true, exposing the database through a public IP interface and increasing its network attack surface."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_GCP_13",
      "title": "Query duration logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_duration flag is absent, limiting visibility into the duration of completed statements during investigations."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_68",
      "title": "Cloud SQL deletion protection is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "deletion_protection is explicitly false, allowing accidental or unauthorized Terraform-driven deletion of the operational database."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource \"google_sql_database_instance\" \"operational_database\" {\n  name             = \"autonomous-drone-delivery-management-platform-sql-operational\"\n  database_version = \"POSTGRES_17\"\n  region           = var.region\n  settings {\n    tier = var.database_tier\n    ip_configuration {\n      ipv4_enabled = false\n      require_ssl  = true\n    }\n    backup_configuration {\n      enabled                        = true\n      start_time                     = \"03:00\"\n      point_in_time_recovery_enabled = true\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_statement\"\n      value = \"all\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"cloudsql.enable_pgaudit\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_checkpoints\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_connections\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_disconnections\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_hostname\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_lock_waits\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_min_messages\"\n      value = \"error\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_duration\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n  }\n  deletion_protection = true\n}\n",
  "fix_summary": "Upgraded PostgreSQL, enabled pgAudit and the required security logging flags, required SSL, and removed public IPv4 exposure and authorized internet access. Deletion protection remains enabled alongside the existing backups and point-in-time recovery."
}
